subject.title: Gemini models output inline buttons as raw JSON text instead of using tool format

question: Should OpenClaw accept a constrained raw `[[...]]` button JSON fallback for model final text, or require Gemini/provider prompting to use typed message-tool presentation buttons only?
rationale: Current source proves the rendering gap, but the parser direction would add a new model-output fallback syntax across final replies, transcript state, and Telegram presentation rendering.

options.title: Accept A Constrained Raw Fallback
options.body: Allow a narrow parser only if the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Gemini/Telegram proof.

options.title: Require Typed Presentation Routing
options.body: Reject raw final-text parsing and focus the fix on provider/tool prompting so Gemini emits `message(action=send)` with structured buttons.

options.title: Wait For Live Reproduction
options.body: Keep this issue open but pause implementation acceptance until a maintainer or reporter supplies live Gemini/Telegram evidence.

recommendation.title: Accept A Constrained Raw Fallback
recommendation.body: Allow a narrow parser only if the linked PR or replacement is rebased, transcript-safe, and backed by redacted live Gemini/Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the typed presentation contract and Telegram button rendering paths where current history points most strongly.
